title: TooFast config
description: The config file of TooFast. Patterns are relative to the config file.

$schema.description: The path or the URL of this schema, so editors can validate the config file.

setupFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns of modules that are loaded before each test file.

testFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns of test files. Files in node_modules are never run.

testOptions.description: The default test options of all tests. Options of describe(), test() and measure() override them.

measureTimeout.description: The maximum measure duration in milliseconds. Doesn't include warmup.

targetRme.description: The relative margin of error of mean iteration durations of batches that stops the measure before measureTimeout.

minBatchCount.description: The number of batches that a measure runs before targetRme can stop it. A few batches can agree by chance while CPU frequency or scheduling is changing. measureTimeout can still end the measure with fewer batches.

maxWarmupBatchIterationCount.description: The maximum number of iterations in the warmup batch. V8 optimizes a function after it was called several thousand times. The warmup batch is also limited by batchTimeout and maxBatchIterationCount. Set to 0 to disable warmup.

maxBatchIterationCount.description: The maximum number of iterations in a batch, including iterations that sample memory and calibrate the duration of a loop. Unlimited by default.

batchTimeout.description: The maximum duration of a batch in milliseconds. A batch times at least one loop.

batchPauseDuration.description: The pause after each batch in milliseconds. VM is expected to run garbage collector during the pause.

minLoopDuration.description: The minimum duration of a loop in milliseconds, so timer resolution and overhead don't distort results of fast callbacks. Loops have a single iteration if there are iteration hooks, and are shorter if maxBatchIterationCount doesn't allow longer loops.

maxBatchMemorySampleCount.description: The maximum number of memory samples in a batch. A memory sample is an iteration after a loop, which allocations are measured instead of its duration. Set to 0 to disable memory measurement.
